France–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force)
France–United Arab Emirates Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), including Articles L.561-2, L.561-5, L.561-5-1, L.561-10 and L.561-46 et seq.; Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.561-46 et seq. and R.561-55 et seq.; AML beneficial-owner filing rules principally under Decree No. 2017-1094 of 12 June 2017, as amended. SARLs identify and file beneficial owners with the commercial court registry through the business-formality process. Since the Court of Justice of the EU judgment in Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20, access to beneficial-owner information is not generally open to the public; access is governed by French law and limited to competent authorities, obliged entities, and persons demonstrating a legitimate interest under applicable rules.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent identity-document authority and utility, governmental, or financial institution in the country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before accepting investors, managers, beneficial owners, lenders, and material counterparties, conduct documented risk-based identity verification, ownership and control tracing, PEP screening, and sanctions screening against applicable EU and French restrictive measures, UN Security Council lists, and relevant foreign lists such as OFAC where legally and commercially relevant. French AML-obliged entities must apply customer due diligence and enhanced measures where required by the Monetary and Financial Code; OFAC screening is not a general French statutory requirement. Identify source of funds and, where risk warrants, source of wealth. Refresh screening periodically and upon material ownership, control, or risk changes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); INPI databases may be used for preliminary company-name and trademark searches. The commercial court registry records the company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A SARL name may generally use French or other permitted characters, subject to French company-law requirements, public policy, and third-party rights. The corporate form must be identified as SARL or Société à responsabilité limitée in statutory documents and business dealings as required by law. No general statutory requirement requires a French-script transliteration of a foreign-language name. Check identical and confusingly similar company names, trade names, domain names, and INPI trademarks separately; registry acceptance does not establish trademark clearance.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Terms suggesting a regulated banking or credit institution, including banque, établissement de crédit, and related protected designations, unless legally authorized
Terms suggesting a regulated payment institution, investment-services provider, insurance undertaking, or other regulated status without the required authorization
Official designations or references to public authorities, France, or public institutions where use is prohibited or requires authorization
Names contrary to public order, good morals, or third-party intellectual-property rights
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not provide a general statutory company-name reservation period; the 30-day reservation assumption is inapplicable. Before filing, conduct INPI trademark and company-name searches and obtain legal clearance. If a name is rejected in a formal registration decision, obtain the reasoned decision, correct the filing or submit a compliant alternative, and use the appeal route and deadline stated in that decision. A decision of the commercial court registry may be challenged before the competent court under applicable registry procedure; seek specialist advice promptly because the competent forum and deadline depend on the decision. A separate INPI trademark refusal follows the appeal procedure and deadlines stated in the INPI decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in France is mandatory under the Commercial Code. A lawful domiciliation provider or qualifying home address may be used subject to statutory conditions and any lease, ownership, or co-ownership restrictions. A virtual office alone does not establish sufficient operational substance for a high-risk consumer-credit or fintech business, satisfy regulatory governance requirements, or guarantee acceptance by a bank, ACPR, ORIAS, or other counterparty. The company must accurately disclose its actual place of management and operational arrangements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official inspection probability is published, and no reliable percentage can be assigned. Regulatory scrutiny is elevated for a consumer-lending fintech: ACPR may assess governance, resources, controls, management location, and operational capacity during authorization or supervision, and other competent authorities may conduct checks under their powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), Book II — Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general rules for commercial companies) and L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL); residual general corporate law in Code civil, Articles 1832 to 1844-17; crowdfunding regulatory perimeter in Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.547-1 et seq. and Regulation (EU) 2020/1503.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) — Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); final registration executed by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court) of the registered-office district.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts de la Société à Responsabilité Limitée (Articles of Association) executed as a private or notarial deed, filed through the National Single Window via the online declaration 'Création d'une société commerciale' (M0-format form).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum for a SARL (Article L.223-2 of the Code de commerce; the capital may be set freely, even at €1). Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and paid up to at least 20% upon incorporation, with the balance payable within five years. The funds must be escrowed in a blocked account at a French credit institution, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or before a notaire, and released only by the manager upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate. Regulatory top-up for the P2P lending perimeter: ECSP authorization requires minimum own funds of €25,000 under Article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2020/1503.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE CONSTITUTIVE SHAREHOLDERS' MEETING OF FRANCE MICRO-LEND SARL. The undersigned shareholders, holding the entire share capital, unanimously resolve: FIRST — Share Subscription and Capital: The full share capital of €[•], divided into [•] equal registered shares, is confirmed as subscribed and allotted; the deposit certificate issued by [Depositary Bank] evidencing blocked funds is approved. SECOND — Registered Office: The registered office is fixed at [Address]; the Gérant is empowered to execute the lease and complete all formalities at the Company Registry. THIRD — Appointment: [Name] is appointed Gérant with full power to represent the Company, including banking, licensing, ACPR/AMF applications, and employment matters. The meeting closes. Minutes signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All founding shareholders; notarization by a notaire where real estate is contributed (optional authentic form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a French avocat or notaire to draft the Statuts in conformity with Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 of the Commercial Code. The corporate purpose must precisely state the operation of an online peer-to-peer micro-lending platform and the regulatory perimeter. Verify the firm name (including optional INPI name reservation), registered office, share capital, rights attached to shares, appointment of the gérant, and statutory audit thresholds. Each shareholder signs every page and initials the final deed; where notarial form is not required, a private deed (acte sous seing privé) with secure electronic signature is sufficient.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts
Valid identity documents or passports of all associates and the appointed gérant
Proof of address of each associate and of the intended registered office
Certificate of firm name availability or negative search extract (where obtained)
Bank certificate evidencing firm name reservation, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the draft, the shareholders adopt rectificative minutes; any missing signature or incomplete initialing is cured by a supplementary execution sheet signed by all parties; where notarial form is required, the notaire rectifies and re-executes the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Cash Capital in a Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A French credit institution (bank), the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC), or the notaire receiving the funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary 'funds to be released' account in the name of the company in formation; each shareholder transfers or deposits the cash contribution; the bank issues the certificate of deposit (certificat de dépôt des fonds) indicating the total amount and the list of contributors. The funds remain blocked and may be released by the gérant only upon production of the RCS registration certificate. The founders should consider committing regulatory own funds (€25,000 minimum for ECSP) at this stage.
required_dossiers: Received draft Statuts
Identity documents of shareholders making the deposits
Beneficial owner information of each subscribing entity, where applicable
Deposit instruction letter naming the company, the intended gérant, and the account holding instructions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional AML/KYC documentation, provide capital-origin statements and updated identity proofs; if the bank refuses service due to the regulated activity, transfer the deposit to the CDC or to a notaire and obtain the corresponding deposit receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Incorporation Notice (Annonce Légale)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An authorized legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales, JAL) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the legal notice containing the proposed company name, corporate form (SARL), share capital, registered office address, corporate object, duration, date and form of the Statuts, and the surname and first name of the gérants. Submit the announcement to an accredited JAL on the official departmental list; the JAL issues the certificate of publication (attestation de parution). Publication is mandatory before filing with the Guichet Unique.
required_dossiers: Final Statuts (or a preparer-approved executive summary of the announcement)
Attestation of the founders or manager confirming the content of the announcement
Order form for the legal announcement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL refuses or corrects the wording, publish a rectificative notice and re-certify; where the Registry later rejects the announcement for inaccuracy, republish with the exact wording required by the Commercial Code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Incorporation Dossier to the National Single Window (Guichet Unique)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) — online portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online declaration 'Création d'une société commerciale' on the official portal; select the RCS registration operation and the mandatory tax/social registrations; attach the scanned Statuts, capital deposit certificate, JAL publication attestation, registered-office lease or domiciliation agreement, identity documents, declaration of beneficial owners, and the managers' declarations of non-conviction; pay the administrative fee online. The file is automatically routed to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
required_dossiers: Online M0-format declaration (Création d'une société commerciale)
Statuts signed by all associates
Bank capital deposit certificate (certificat de dépôt des fonds)
Attestation de parution from the JAL
Registered-office lease or domiciliation agreement (attestation de domiciliation)
Identity cards and proof of address of the gérants
Declaration of non-conviction (déclaration sur l'honneur) of the gérants
Declaration of beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs)
Statement regarding the intended ACPR/AMF licensing procedure for the lending platform activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet Unique or the Greffe issues a procedural query, supply the missing documents within the statutory 15-working-day deadline; if the dossier is rejected, reactivate the same draft with corrected attachments or file a fresh registration using the previously reserved company name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Register of Commerce and Companies and Issue of the K-bis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court) of the court district of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Greffe verifies legal conformity of the Statuts and attachments, registers the company under a single SIREN/SIRET identifier, transcribes the RCS entry, and issues the official K-bis extract evidencing incorporation. The company legally exists from the date of RCS registration. The gérant presents the K-bis to the depositary bank to release the blocked capital.
required_dossiers: The complete dossier as transmitted from the Guichet Unique
Proof of payment of registration taxes and fees
Delivery receipt or tracking reference of the e-registration from INPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query, correct the dossier within the granted 15-day delay and resubmit through the portal; where registration is refused due to a conflicting name or unlawful corporate object, amend the Statuts by private or notarial act and re-file; an appeal may be lodged with the judge supervising the register (juge commis à la surveillance du RCS).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Tax and Beneficial Ownership Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); URSSAF; Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs at the Greffe; professional banking department; ORIAS and ACPR/AMF where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the K-bis, convene the first official management meeting; open the definitive professional bank account; file the initial register of beneficial owners with the Greffe within 15 days of RCS registration; the DGFiP automatically assigns the corporation-tax code (impôt sur les sociétés) and the VAT status; for the micro-lending perimeter, initiate the ACPR/AMF licensing process and the ORIAS registration; adopt AML/CTF internal procedures and appoint a compliance officer before any lending transaction is undertaken.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
SIREN identification number and company identification details
Register of beneficial owners template with supporting identity documents
Minutes of the first management committee or shareholders' meeting
AML internal control program and compliance officer appointment letter
Operational bank account opening forms
ORIAS registration form for crowdfunding intermediation, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the beneficial-owner register is challenged, correct the identification with official translations and apostilles; if the bank refuses account opening due to the regulated activity, apply to the Banque de France for the exercise of the right to an account (droit au compte).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) jointly with the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF); the official registration office ORIAS acts as the entry point for crowdfunding intermediation registrations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP) authorization for the lending perimeter — Regulation (EU) 2020/1503, transposed in Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.547-1 et seq.; complementary ORIAS immatriculation (Intermédiaire en Financement Participatif).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) — Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / not classifiable — the platform operates exclusively as an administrative fintech service without industrial machinery, installations classées ICPE, or wet processes; only urban-planning and office-energy compliance obligations apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluents, VOCs, or process emissions; office waste sorted and collected per municipal rules under Code de l'environnement, Article R.541-8; end-of-life IT equipment routed to the DEEE/WEEE recycling stream; any server room complies with NF C 15-100 electrical safety and RE2020 thermal regulation thresholds for heat load.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification for the premises under ERP (Établissement Recevant du Public) class X or R, as applicable, with annual extinguisher control and evacuation exercise; structural feasibility confirmed by the commercial lease technical file; occupational-health clearance by CARSAT or the occupational physician for permanent workstation usage, in accordance with Articles R.4222-1 et seq. of the Labour Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL entities obtain SIREN/SIRET identifiers through guichet-entreprises.fr or via a tax advisor; VAT identification number (TVA) is assigned automatically upon registration with DGFiP. Foreign-owned entities with French branches or permanent establishments register similarly under the same process.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections available; French SARL entities are subject to default entity-level taxation under the Impôt sur les Sociétés regime. Specific elections include micro-entreprise taxation or holding company regimes under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive; hybrid mismatch rules governed by the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturation Électronique de Titre (FET) for all B2B transactions with real-time transmission to DGFiP and digital fiscal stamps (certificats de signature électronique) for clearance and audit compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the EU or services supplied to non-EU clients, subject to proof of export or service delivery; intra-EU supplies are subject to the reverse charge mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment to non-EU recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in penalties up to 80% of the evaded tax plus interest, retrospective clawback of VAT credits, and potential criminal prosecution under French tax evasion provisions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, acting as the French foreign-exchange statistics authority and balance-of-payments reporting centre under the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier); the euro-area monetary policy authority is the European Central Bank within the Eurosystem, while prudential licensing and supervision of credit institutions, payment institutions, and e-money institutions rests with the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) and exchange-control policy oversight sits with the Direction Générale du Trésor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full current-account and capital-account convertibility under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, the OECD Code of Liberalisation of Capital Movements, and IMF Article VIII status. The euro is freely convertible and there are no quantitative limits on profit remittance, dividend distribution, interest payments, royalty payments, loan repayments, or liquidation proceeds to non-residents. Practical constraints are documentary: the platform must file tax-residence documentation, apply treaty relief forms, and comply with sanctions screening, but no prior administrative authorization or conversion restriction applies to any treasury flow. All financial transactions must be routed through an authorized intermediary bank under Articles L.151-1 to L.151-7 of the Monetary and Financial Code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio apply in France. Export receipts, loan collections, interest income, and platform fees may be retained in EUR or in any freely convertible foreign currency and may be repatriated without penalty. The only binding regulatory requirement is statistical: any cross-border transaction exceeding EUR 12,500 must be reported by the SARL's French bank to Banque de France in the monthly balance-of-payments bulletin de liaison; banks are the declarants, and the corporate treasury's duty is to provide correct purpose codes and supporting documents so the bank can classify the operation under the CN 2023 statistical nomenclature.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. / Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Compte de séquestre) and Operational Account (Compte de fonctionnement)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM HIGH. A non-French EU-licensed EMI or payment institution can passport e-money and payment services into France under PSD2 via the ACPR notification procedure, which resolves the payment-rail and wallet layer. However, e-money and payment-service passporting alone cannot authorize P2P micro-lending activity in France: the lending platform itself requires an ACPR authorization as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSPR / prestataire de services de financement participatif) with ESMA registration and an ORIAS-listed intermediation status, and no EMI licence on its own authorizes the granting of credit. The workable structure is an ACPR-licensed ECSPR borrower-lending platform holding client funds under the safeguarding rules in a French credit institution or an EU EMI, with the EMI operating SEPA Direct Debits and local wallet payouts. French regulators apply enhanced scrutiny to outsourcing, white-labeling, and sub-agent arrangements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the gérant and each beneficial owner is the de facto market requirement for a high-risk fintech client. Under Articles L.561-5 and L.561-5-1 of the Monetary and Financial Code and ACPR guidance, the bank must verify identity using reliable independent-source documents; an in-person commercial due-diligence interview with the relationship manager and the bank's Financial Crime Unit is mandatory for the high-risk special-license tier. Remote opening may be accepted only where the bank recognizes an eIDAS-qualified electronic signature and a video-verification procedure aligned with the ACPR digital-onboarding position and CNIL data-protection consent rules, but account activation will remain subject to a completed physical interview at the bank's French premises. Budget for a six-to-ten-week onboarding timeline including internal compliance committee validation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Register-keeper and beneficial-ownership opacity: the SARL is held by a non-resident corporate parent through a tiered or cascade ownership chain, triggering the bank's Politically Exposed Persons and beneficial-ownership review under Articles L.561-2-2 and R.561-1 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized statutes (statuts) and any pactes d'associés; K-bis extract issued within three months; the register of beneficial owners (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) filed with the greffe; the register of securities movements; a detailed ownership organigramme showing percentages, share classes, and voting rights; original passports or national identity cards of the gérant and every natural-person beneficial owner holding 25% or more; proof of residential address for each beneficial owner; sworn French translations of all non-French documents; and a written commercial-rationale letter explaining the non-resident holding structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector-risk flag: automated algorithm-underwritten micro-lending (ISIC 6499) classified by the bank as High_Risk_Special_License, generating heightened money-laundering, cyber-fraud, consumer-protection, and financial-exclusion scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The ACPR authorization decision as ECSPR provider or, if pending, the official ACPR acknowledgement of application together with the ORIAS registration number; the platform's lending policy and underwriting-algorithm governance documentation covering model validation, exclusion rules, scoring fairness, and bias testing; a full AML/CFT compliance manual (dispositif LCB-FT) with risk classification, customer due-diligence procedures, TRACFIN suspicious-transaction escalation protocols, training records, and the compliance-officer mandate; transaction-monitoring system specifications; sanctions-screening coverage of ONU, EU, UK, and OFAC lists; cybersecurity and operational-resilience documentation aligned with DORA; and the CNIL data-processing register where personal data are used in automated scoring.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Funding-concentration blocker: initial and recurring capital injections and treasury advances from non-resident shareholders, requiring a defensible source-of-wealth and source-of-funds narrative.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twenty-four months of contributor bank statements; tax returns, dividend warrants, or sale agreements evidencing lawful accumulation of wealth; the notarized capital-subscription deed and the bank certificate of deposit des fonds; shareholders' written resolutions (procès-verbal); a formal shareholder current-account agreement (convention de compte courant d'associé) if funds enter as intercompany advances; pre-notification to the bank's Financial Crime Unit with the wire amount, counterparty, purpose code, and confirmation that all beneficial owners are cleared against PEP and sanctions lists; and any parent-letter of comfort or capital-support undertaking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Retail-money-movement flag: mass disbursement of micro-loans, wallet top-ups, refunds, and instant-credit settlement patterns that, without a documented narrative, resemble layering or structuring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A banking-narrative questionnaire and flow diagram describing the treasury architecture: segregated client-funds account (compte de cantonnement) under the ECSPR safeguarding rules, the whitelist of approved payment service providers and wallet partners, and the disbursement waterfall; specimen loan agreements, borrower eligibility rules, interest and fee schedules; a Commissaire aux comptes or external auditor attestation confirming funds segregation and reconciliation; transaction-monitoring thresholds, alert logic, and reconciliation frequency; projected transaction volumes and the geographical map of origin and destination counterparties; regulatory capital and liquidity evidence; and the ACPR periodic reporting schedule references.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 for EUR and non-EUR injections from the non-resident parent to the SARL's EUR operational account (IBAN FR76...). The payment order must carry the French balance-of-payments reason code under the CN 2023 nomenclature: for an equity increase, use the direct-investment equity code for participation in the capital of a resident enterprise; for a shareholder advance, use the direct-investment intercompany-advance code. The French bank will record the bulletin de liaison automatically for any cross-border operation above EUR 12,500, so the remitter must include a clear purpose description in the Remittance Information field. Supporting documents to pre-submit to the bank's Financial Crime Unit include the notarized capital-increase deed or shareholders' resolution, the bank certificate of deposit des fonds, the share-subscription statement, and beneficial-owner declarations. For EUR flows within the SEPA area, a standard SEPA Credit Transfer with identical purpose text is sufficient, while non-EUR flows require the structured SWIFT MT103 with notarized source-of-funds evidence; any inbound wire with an ambiguous purpose code or missing voided-documentation package will be rejected or frozen.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails available through the French bank: (1) SWIFT MT103 for cross-border vendor, partner, interest, and dividend payments, with the correct CN 2023 reason code, full beneficiary legal name, IBAN or account number, and applicable tax documentation for reduced withholding; (2) irrevocable commercial letters of credit subject to UCP 600 and documentary collections under URC 522 for trade-linked settlements where the platform purchases software, equipment, or services cross-border; (3) SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for EEA disbursements, including wallet payouts to borrowers executed through the licensed ECSPR or EMI partner; (4) SEPA Direct Debit Core and B2B mandates for collecting micro-loan installments from borrower accounts; (5) local-wallet and payment-institution settlements via the EMI partner's clearing infrastructure. All transactions settle in TARGET2 or EURO1 at the repository bank, and all outbound payments above EUR 12,500 are captured in the bank's monthly balance-of-payments return to Banque de France, requiring accurate purpose codes and documentary evidence retained in the treasury archive.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward (change à terme ferme) in EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and other freely convertible major currencies, with tenors matched to the platform's lending-cycle and funding-maturity profile.
FX swap (swap de change) for short-term liquidity management between EUR and USD or GBP clearing floats.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) for hedging non-convertible or restricted emerging-market currencies such as CNY, INR, or NGN where the platform holds genuine non-EUR collection or investment exposure, subject to treasury-policy approval and documented hedge intent.
Cross-currency interest-rate swap (CCIRS / swap de devises et de taux) for matched-funding of cross-currency shareholder advances, loans, or bond-style funding.
Vanilla FX option (option de change) purchased for risk management of committed foreign-currency receipts; writing of naked options is not permitted under conservative French bank treasury policies.

FX collar and participating-forward structures available at the bank's bilateral discretion, provided the position is demonstrably non-speculative and aligned with the SARL's approved treasury and hedging strategy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders meeting approving the annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders; no government filing for the meeting itself
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of each financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers may be ordered by the commercial court to convene the meeting. Failure to prepare or approve accounts may create civil and criminal exposure. No automatic annual administrative strike-off applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts and applicable management report filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registry of the Commercial Court through the French Companies Formalities Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval; two months if filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may result in a civil fine of approximately EUR 1,500, increased for repeat non-compliance, and a court injunction. Persistent inactivity or failure to regularize may contribute to registry radiation procedures, but there is no fixed automatic annual strike-off date.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return Form 2065 and tax package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year company, by the second business day after 1 May of the following year; otherwise generally within three months after financial year-end, subject to electronic filing rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing interest generally accrues at 0.20% per month, with a standard 10% surcharge that may increase for formal non-compliance or repeated default. Tax reassessment and collection measures may follow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Value-added tax returns and annual VAT reconciliation, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly CA3 returns, or annual CA12 return under the applicable VAT regime; deadlines are stated in the company's tax account
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing may trigger 0.20% monthly interest, a standard 10% surcharge, denial of deductions, and tax audit or reassessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registry of the Commercial Court through the French Companies Formalities Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No annual confirmation filing is required. File an update promptly and generally within 30 days after any change in beneficial ownership, control, or relevant information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to declare or maintain accurate beneficial ownership information may result in a court injunction, criminal penalties for responsible persons, and restrictions on access to certain corporate formalities. No automatic annual strike-off rule applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Regulated-fintech authorization and periodic regulatory reporting, if operating as a crowdfunding service provider, payment institution, lending intermediary, or other regulated entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Autorité des Marchés Financiers, Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution, ORIAS, or another competent authority, depending on the authorization perimeter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: According to the applicable authorization, annual contribution, renewal, prudential, AML, consumer-protection, and statistical reporting calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warnings, remediation orders, monetary penalties, temporary or permanent authorization restrictions, deregistration, and prohibition of regulated activity may apply. The exact obligations depend on the platform's legal qualification and lending model.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL generally must appoint a statutory auditor when it exceeds at least two of three thresholds: EUR 5 million total balance sheet, EUR 10 million net turnover, and 50 average employees. Appointment may also be required for certain controlled or controlling company structures, regulated activities, or specific statutory circumstances. A regulated lending or crowdfunding platform must separately assess sector-specific audit and reporting requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French Generally Accepted Accounting Principles under the French Accounting Standards Authority regulations, with IFRS generally permitted or required only in specified group or regulated reporting contexts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not generally require an annual beneficial ownership confirmation solely because a new year begins. The SARL must maintain accurate beneficial ownership information and file an update after any change in ownership, voting rights, control, or identifying data. Share transfers must be documented, recorded in the share transfer register and members' records, and reflected in the beneficial ownership filing where relevant.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and share transfer records
Register of Managers and corporate officers
Minute Book of shareholder and management resolutions
Annual accounts and supporting accounting records
Beneficial ownership documentation and filed declarations

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 300-1,500 per year, depending on location, mail handling, domiciliation services, and compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 5,000-20,000 for a small SARL requiring a certified statutory audit; regulated lending or crowdfunding operations may materially increase the fee

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable income for qualifying SMEs with turnover below EUR 10 million; remaining profit taxed at 25%. Large taxpayers face an effective marginal rate of approximately 25.83% due to the 3.3% social contribution on corporate tax exceeding EUR 763,000. Primary incentives: Research Tax Credit (CIR) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenditure, Innovation Tax Credit (CII) of 20%, Young Innovative Company (JEI) exemptions, and the mother-daughter participation exemption (99% of qualifying dividends excluded from taxable income).
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite) carryforward subject to an annual utilization cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding that amount; limited 1-year carryback capped at EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (Déclaration de résultats) and the accompanying liasse fiscale (2050 to 2135 series, TP annex 2257-SD, RCI credits schedule), filed electronically via the French professional e-filing portal (TéléTVA / impots.gouv.fr, EFI-EDI mode, or approved EDI software).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual CIT return; four quarterly advance instalments (15 March, 15 June, 15 September, 15 December) with final balance due at the annual filing date.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal years ending 31 December, the return must be filed by the second business day after 1 May. For fiscal years ending at any other date, the return is due within three months of the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: registered SIREN number, APE/NAF code, registered office address, election of tax regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Completed by the SARL's French accountant; non-resident shareholders have no filing obligation for this line unless they operate a French permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after book profit reconciliation, including reintegrations of non-deductible expenses (vehicle charges, penalties, excessive interest) and deduction of exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for shareholders; a non-resident lender with a French PE of the SARL activity files on this line using its own French 2065-SD return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss of the current fiscal year available for carryforward under the unlimited carryforward regime with statutory annual cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable at shareholder level; only the French tax-resident SARL claims the loss carryforward on its own return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly advance CIT instalments paid during the year, credited against the final corporate tax assessment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Instalments are paid by the SARL from its French bank account; no shareholder reporting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits including the Research Tax Credit (CIR), Innovation Tax Credit (CII), and foreign-source tax credits requiring supporting schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only credits attributable to the French PE or the SARL itself may be claimed; foreign shareholders cannot offset their personal taxes against SARL credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual declaration of related-party transactions with non-resident entities, including loans, guarantee fees, algorithm licensing, and profit attribution, where the statutory turnover threshold is met.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SARL must complete this annex if it controls or is controlled by the foreign parent and its annual turnover equals or exceeds EUR 50 million; the non-resident shareholder provides supporting data but does not file the French annex.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic 10% majoration of net tax due, increased to 40% if still unfiled 30 days after formal notice, and 80% for bad faith or fraudulent schemes; all late amounts additionally bear monthly interest of 0.2% (2.4% annualized). Non-electronic filing when e-filing is mandatory attracts a fixed fine of EUR 150; omission of the TP annex or RCI schedules triggers EUR 150 per schedule penalty.
